==Usage==
This template can be placed on the user page and/or talk page of permanently blocked users, particularly those with an extensive editing history. <code><nowiki>{{Banned|global}}</nowiki></code> can be used for editors globally banned by Fandom.

For unblocks, see [[Template:AppealReason]]
